extracted.intended_audience: users of the PARI/GP library (computational number theory programmers and mathematicians using PARI/GP)
extracted.subtask_description: Reference documentation for PARI/GP routines dealing with number fields and relative extensions: function syntax, expected inputs, outputs, flags, limitations, warnings, and examples for correct usage.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfroots
rubrics_metrics.description: Roots of the polynomial x in the number field nf given by nfinit, without multiplicity (or in Q if nf is omitted). The main variable of nf must have lower priority than that of x. If coefficients of nf occur explicitly as polmods in x, their variable must match the main variable of T.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN nfroots(GEN nf = NULL, GEN x). You may pass a defining polynomial instead of an nf structure (less efficient). Caveat: nfinit([T,listP]) may produce a conditional nf with non-maximal nf.zk; either run nfcertify first or pass nf.pol to avoid missing factors. See nfrootsQ for related functionality.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfrootsof1
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns [w, z] where w is the number of roots of unity in the number field nf and z is a primitive w-th root of unity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN rootsof1(GEN nf). The routine guesses w via gcd of #k(v)* for unramified v above odd primes then computes roots of the w-th cyclotomic polynomial; polynomial-time in field degree and bitsize of multiplication table. Alternative: rootsof1_kannan uses Kronecker's theorem (may be faster when roots of unity exist but can be exponential and much slower for large degree). Fields up to degree ~100 should be quick.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfsnf (Smith normal form of torsion ZK-module)
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a torsion ZK-module x (attached to a square integral invertible pseudo-matrix (A,I,J)), returns an ideal list D = [d1,...,dn] that is the Smith normal form of x (x ≅ ZK/d1 ⊕ ... ⊕ ZK/dn with di | di-1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If flag non-zero return [D,U,V] with UAV = identity. Input x is a 3-component row vector [A,I,J] describing the pseudo-matrix; integrality conditions must hold (ai,j ∈ bi a−1 i). Library syntax: GEN nfsnf0(GEN nf, GEN x, long flag); also GEN nfsnf(GEN nf, GEN x) (flag=0).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfsolvemodpr (obsolete)
rubrics_metrics.description: Solves a · x = b over a residue field given a prime ideal P in modpr format: a invertible matrix, b a column vector/matrix; returns solution x with coefficients lifted to nf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This function is obsolete; use nfmodpr. Example usage shown. Library syntax: GEN nfsolvemodpr(GEN nf, GEN a, GEN b, GEN P). For library-mode prefer projecting inputs to the residue field with nfM to FqM and work there.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfsplitting
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes a defining polynomial over Q for the splitting field of polynomial P (the smallest field over which P totally splits). If P is reducible the splitting field degree can be smaller than deg(P).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a degree bound d is given it must be a multiple of the splitting field degree and can speed computation. Complexity polynomial in splitting field degree d and bitsize of input; results may be unusable if d large. Library syntax: GEN nfsplitting(GEN P, GEN d = NULL). Examples show degree hints drastically reducing time; incorrect bounds are warned and ignored.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfsubfields
rubrics_metrics.description: Finds all subfields of degree d (or all subfields if d omitted) of the number field defined by a monic integral polynomial pol. Each subfield returned as [g,h] where g is an absolute equation and h expresses a root of g in terms of root x of pol.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Uses Klüners's algorithm generally and Allombert's galoissubfields when nf is Galois (weakly supersolvable Galois group). Library syntax: GEN nfsubfields(GEN pol, long d).

rubrics_metrics.name: polcompositum
rubrics_metrics.description: Given squarefree polynomials P and Q in Z[X] (same variable), outputs simple factors of the étale Q-algebra Q(X,Y)/(P(X),Q(Y)) as polynomials R defining the compositums; sorted by increasing degree.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns error if inputs not squarefree. More efficient to reduce P and Q to irreducible factors first. If P and Q irreducible and linearly disjoint there is a single factor R. Binary flag bits adjust output format: bit 1 returns [R,a,b,k] with root expressions; bit 2 assumes linear disjointness to avoid costly factorization and returns single factor. Examples show polredbest to reduce complicated defining polynomials afterwards. Library syntax: GEN polcompositum0(GEN P, GEN Q, long flag); also GEN compositum(GEN P, GEN Q) and compositum2.

rubrics_metrics.name: polgalois
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes the Galois group of an irreducible polynomial T ∈ Q[X] (current version constrained to degree ≤ 7 unless galdata package installed). Returns [n, s, k, name] describing group size, signature, numbering, and name.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Method uses resolvent polynomials and is precision-sensitive; wrong results can occur if initial precision insufficient. Output k historically inconsistent for d≤7; a global new_galois_format variable can be set to 1 to use consistent numbering (standard numbering of transitive subgroups of Sn). Library syntax: GEN polgalois(GEN T, long prec).

rubrics_metrics.name: polred (deprecated)
rubrics_metrics.description: Deprecated: finds polynomials with reasonably small coefficients defining subfields of the number field defined by T; one polynomial defines Q and another defines same field as T if T irreducible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All T accepted by nfinit are allowed; recommended input format [T,listP]. Binary flag bits: 1 allows using a suborder, 2 returns elements with minimal polynomials. Use polredbest instead for better performance. Library syntax: polred(GEN T) (flag = 0) and polred2 for flag=2.

rubrics_metrics.name: polredabs
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a canonical defining polynomial P for Q[X]/(T) minimizing T2-norm (sum of squares of modulus of roots); different T defining isomorphic fields yield same P. Input supports T accepted by nfinit including [T,listP] and nf/bnf structures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Warning: using t_POL T requires factoring discriminant dK of maximal order which may be hard; use [T,listP] or polredbest/polredabs(,16) to avoid factorization at cost of non-canonical output. Complexity polynomial for fixed degree but exponential in degree when many subfields exist. Flag bits: 1 returns [P,a]; 4 gives all polynomials of minimal T2-norm, 16 may use suborder without certification (non-canonical). Library syntax: GEN polredabs0(GEN T, long flag) and nf_PARTIALFACT/nf_ORIG/nf_RAW/nf_ADDZK/nf_ALL for programmatic flags.

rubrics_metrics.name: polredbest
rubrics_metrics.description: Finds a polynomial with reasonably small coefficients defining the same number field as T; runs in polynomial time but offers no minimality guarantee (generally good practical candidate).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Method: compute LLL-reduced basis of an order, examine small combinations and their characteristic polynomials, return separable polynomial with smallest discriminant and lexicographically smallest abs(coef) in ties. Repeated application may improve result until stable. Flag=1 returns [P,a] with an isomorphism element. Library syntax: GEN polredbest(GEN T, long flag).

rubrics_metrics.name: polredord (obsolete)
rubrics_metrics.description: Obsolete; replaced by polredbest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN polredord(GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: poltschirnhaus
rubrics_metrics.description: Applies a random Tschirnhausen transformation to a non-constant separable polynomial x to obtain a new equation for the étale algebra defined by x.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful when computing resolvents; used by polgalois. Library syntax: GEN tschirnhaus(GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfalgtobasis
rubrics_metrics.description: Expresses an element x (given in absolute form) on the relative integral basis for a relative number field extension rnf (L/K) as output by rnfinit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inputs: rnf from rnfinit, x an element of L in absolute polynomial/polmod form. Library syntax: GEN rnfalgtobasis(GEN rnf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfbasis
rubrics_metrics.description: Given bnf for K and a projective ZK-module M (pseudo-basis of size n), returns either a true ZK-basis of M (size n) if it exists, or an n+1 element generating set if not. If M given as a monic irreducible polynomial P in K[X], M is ring of integers of K[X]/(P).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN rnfbasis(GEN bnf, GEN M).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfbasistoalg
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes representation of x (given on relative integral basis) as a polmod with polmod coefficients, for a relative extension rnf = L/K.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inputs: rnf from rnfinit and x expressed on relative integral basis. Library syntax: GEN rnfbasistoalg(GEN rnf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfcharpoly
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes the characteristic polynomial of element a over nf where a belongs to the algebra nf[X]/(T); returns polynomial in given variable (v default x).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Main variable of nf must be lower priority than that of T. Library syntax: GEN rnfcharpoly(GEN nf, GEN T, GEN a, long var = -1). Example provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfconductor
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a bnf structure for K and a monic irreducible polynomial T ∈ K[x] defining an Abelian extension L = K[x]/(T), computes the class field theory conductor of the extension, returning [conductor, bnr, subgroup].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns conductor as [f0,f∞], bnr structure and subgroup matrix in HNF. Format [T,B] accepted to factor over primes p < B to get correct valuations at those primes; valuations at other primes may be incorrect. Library syntax: GEN rnfconductor(GEN bnf, GEN T).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfdedekind
rubrics_metrics.description: Applies Dedekind's criterion to the order ZK[X]/(P) at a prime ideal pr for a relative extension L/K given nf and monic P ∈ ZK[X], irreducible over K. If pr omitted tests maximality at all primes and sets flag automatically to 1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Default returns [max,basis,v] where basis is pseudo-basis of enlarged order O, max=1 if O proven pr-maximal else 0, v is valuation at pr of order discriminant. If flag non-zero, returns 1/0 indicating pr-maximality (faster). Accepts vector of primes to test multiple primes. Can be used with non-monic P (with caveats). Library syntax: GEN rnfdedekind(GEN nf, GEN pol, GEN pr = NULL, long flag). See examples comparing to rnfpseudobasis.

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfdet
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a pseudo-matrix M over the maximal order of nf, computes its determinant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN rnfdet(GEN nf, GEN M).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfdisc
rubrics_metrics.description: Given nf for K and a monic irreducible polynomial T ∈ K[x] defining relative extension L = K[x]/(T), computes the relative discriminant [D,d] where D is relative ideal discriminant and d ∈ K*/K*2.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Main variable priorities apply (Section 2.5.3). Format [T,B] accepted to compute an order maximal at all p < B (valuations correct for those primes). Library syntax: GEN rnfdiscf(GEN nf, GEN T).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfeltabstorel
rubrics_metrics.description: For rnf = L/K and x an element of L given in absolute form (polmod or basis), express x as an element of the relative extension L/K as a polmod with polmod coefficients.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires rnfinit output; if absolute nf structure not initialized may raise incorrect type error — call nfinit(rnf) first to initialize absolute structure. Library syntax: GEN rnfeltabstorel(GEN rnf, GEN x). Examples show allowed input formats and errors.

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfeltdown
rubrics_metrics.description: Given rnf = L/K and x in L expressed with polmod/polmod coefficients (or as t_COL on nfinit(rnf).zk), computes x as an element of K: as t_POLMOD if flag=0, or t_COL otherwise. Domain error if x not in K.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show behavior with different inputs and the need for nfinit(rnf) if absolute nf not initialized. Library syntax: GEN rnfeltdown0(GEN rnf, GEN x, long flag); also GEN rnfeltdown(GEN rnf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfeltnorm
rubrics_metrics.description: Given relative extension rnf = L/K and element x ∈ L, returns the relative norm N_{L/K}(x) as element of K.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN rnfeltnorm(GEN rnf, GEN x). Examples show norms of algebraic elements and integers.

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfeltreltoabs
rubrics_metrics.description: For rnf = L/K and x expressed with polmod with polmod coefficients (relative form), computes x as an element of the absolute extension L/Q as polynomial modulo the absolute equation rnf.pol.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN rnfeltreltoabs(GEN rnf, GEN x). Examples illustrate conversion of relative expressions to absolute polmod modulo rnf.pol.

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfelttrace
rubrics_metrics.description: For rnf = L/K and x ∈ L, returns the relative trace Tr_{L/K}(x) as an element of K.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN rnfelttrace(GEN rnf, GEN x). Example outputs shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfeltup
rubrics_metrics.description: Given rnf = L/K and x ∈ K, computes x as an element of the absolute extension L/Q: as a t_POLMOD modulo rnf.pol if flag=0 and as t_COL on absolute field integer basis if flag=1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accepts x given as element of K or as vectors w.r.t K.zk. Examples show different flag behaviors and outputs. Library syntax: GEN rnfeltup0(GEN rnf, GEN x, long flag).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfequation
rubrics_metrics.description: Given nf (or polynomial) for K and a polynomial pol with coefficients in nf defining a relative extension L of nf, computes an absolute equation of L over Q. If pol reducible but squarefree result is absolute equation of étale algebra.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Main variable priority applies. If flag non-zero returns [z,a,k] where z is absolute equation, a expresses a root α of base field modulo z, and k is small integer with θ = β + kα being a root of z (β root of pol). Guaranteed k=0 when Q(β)=L. Library syntax: GEN rnfequation0(GEN nf, GEN pol, long flag); also rnfequation and rnfequation2 wrapper variants.

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfhnfbasis
rubrics_metrics.description: Given bnf for K and polynomial x with coefficients in bnf defining relative extension L (or pseudo-basis), returns true bnf-basis of L in upper triangular Hermite normal form if it exists, otherwise returns 0.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN rnfhnfbasis(GEN bnf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfidealabstorel
rubrics_metrics.description: Given rnf = L/K and an ideal x of the absolute extension L/Q (in any format attached to Labs = nfinit(rnf)), returns the relative pseudo-matrix in HNF giving x viewed as ZK-module (ideal of L seen as ideal of relative extension L/K).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If Labs available you may pass absolute HNF ideals; if Labs not available you may pass a Z-basis for x (entries modulo rnf.polabs or rnf.pol). Examples show round-trip checks. Library syntax: GEN rnfidealabstorel(GEN rnf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfidealdown
rubrics_metrics.description: Given rnf = L/K and x an ideal of L (relative form or Z-basis), returns the ideal of K below x (intersection x ∩ K).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN rnfidealdown(GEN rnf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfidealfactor
rubrics_metrics.description: Factors an ideal x of the absolute number field L = nfinit(rnf) into prime ideal powers. Output format similar to factor; prime ideals in same representation as idealprimedec for L.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Input ideals of base field K must be explicitly lifted to L via rnfidealup before factoring. Library syntax: GEN rnfidealfactor(GEN rnf, GEN x). Examples illustrate factoring elements and HNF ideals.

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfidealhnf
rubrics_metrics.description: Given rnf = L/K and x a relative ideal (many input types allowed), computes the HNF pseudo-matrix attached to x viewed as a ZK-module.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN rnfidealhnf(GEN rnf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfidealmul
rubrics_metrics.description: Given rnf = L/K and ideals x and y of L/K given by pseudo-matrices, returns the ideal product as a relative ideal (pseudo-matrix).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN rnfidealmul(GEN rnf, GEN x, GEN y).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfidealnormabs
rubrics_metrics.description: Given rnf = L/K and a relative ideal x (many input types), computes the norm of x considered as an ideal of the absolute extension L/Q; faster equivalent to idealnorm(rnf, rnfidealnormrel(rnf,x)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN rnfidealnormabs(GEN rnf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfidealnormrel
rubrics_metrics.description: Given rnf = L/K and a relative ideal x, computes the relative norm of x as an ideal of K in HNF.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN rnfidealnormrel(GEN rnf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfidealprimedec
rubrics_metrics.description: Given rnf = L/K and a maximal ideal pr of K (prid), completes rnf with an nf structure attached to L if needed and returns the prime ideal decomposition of pr in L/K. If argument is a rational prime p returns [SK,SL] where SK contains primes of K above p and SL[i] lists primes of L above SK[i].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN rnfidealprimedec(GEN rnf, GEN pr). Example shows usage and interpreting returned vectors; useful to query decomposition above rational primes as well.
